newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan overnight rates firm at 9.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Jordan overnight rates firm at 9.75 pct.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Jordanian dinar were firm at 9.750 on Wednesday compared with 9.50 Tuesday, brokers said.
But several brokers expected the market to ease next week after some banks completed end-of-month window dressing.

"The market continues to be very tight even though the Jordan Cement Company changed a $15 million syndicated loan into dinars...and this should have increased liquidity in the market," said one dealer.
"The market should have eased but the Supply Ministry is also said to have withdrawn some money from banks."
Another added: "I expect the situation to ease soon because several banks finished end-of-month window dressing."
